scope: Independent public concept. No business, investment, tenancy, building-design or operating approval is represented. Existing 9-case and 7-night-city evidence records remain applicable.

claims.claim: PDA charter includes fostering small businesses; craft daystall participation includes makers selling their own products.
claims.confidence: high for mission; profitability not established
claims.proposal: Transparent small-unit and short-term tenant selection plus disclosed total occupancy costs on B1 and 2F.
claims.limitation: Rent discounts and turnover rents are MDL proposals, not a claim about all Pike Place leases.

claims.claim: Granville Island 2040 describes market rental revenue supporting arts and culture.
claims.locator: Strategy 2 economic engine / arts and culture
claims.confidence: high for stated mechanism; current surplus not audited here
claims.proposal: Budget culture at operator level, supported first by committed funding; allocate only available surplus after full operating costs, repair reserves and working capital.
claims.limitation: Tenant sales/profit and landlord/operator income are separate. Evening activation in the source is a plan, not a measured outcome.

claims.claim: Time Out describes selection by its editorial team and coexistence with the traditional market.
claims.locator: Who we are / selection / traditional market
claims.confidence: high for configuration; not independent demand evidence
claims.proposal: An accountable food curator selects local operators, seasonality and accessible price bands for the B1/1F core.
claims.limitation: Shimonoseki demand and profitability are unmeasured.

claims.claim: King’s Cross combines work, residences, education, retail and public space.
claims.locator: About the development / mix of uses
claims.proposal: 5F learning/work/community with repeat users and actual operating partners identified first.
claims.limitation: Repeat visits and net jobs are hypotheses in Shimonoseki. Prior 2021 link is retained in the historic evidence snapshot; current page now links this source.

claims.claim: Smith Street master-tenant quality selection and SG Heritage Business Scheme support are different mechanisms.
claims.proposal: Publish operator/tenant selection reasons and connect heritage storytelling to business and successor support.
claims.limitation: No claim of existing local-preference lease entitlement or direct cash subsidy under the heritage scheme.

claims.claim: Markthal food experience, Bilbao integrated district planning, Battersea reuse/access and Medellin inclusive access inform spatial conditions across floors.
claims.proposal: 1F food/Trip Studio connects the building to existing city and Kanmon transport, shops and public space.
claims.limitation: These examples do not establish the suitability or value of the subject building or a specific floor allocation.

claims.claim: Six conceptual places form one jointly curated building: B1 pantry, 1F local table/trip gateway, 2F makers, 3F Kanmon play, 4F theatre, 5F learning/work.
conditions: fire escape and evening vertical circulation
claims.limitation: 3F game is MDL original, not a foreign case performance claim. Floors and sequence are provisional. Roof/6F/7F not committed.

decision_contract.audience: MDL special-site readers and prospective local participants
decision_contract.decision: Publish a clearer conditional in-building concept; no capital or operating commitment
decision_contract.owner: MDL for proposal; asset, funding and operator decision owners require agreement
decision_contract.next_action: Survey usable spaces, operators, demand and full costs before authorizing a paid trial
decision_contract.approval_status: Site update authorized; redevelopment and experiment not authorized or executed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Curated food plus one local experience creates incremental spend and paid repeat visits.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Activity displaces existing district purchases; upper-floor costs exceed additional income.
hypotheses.test: Compare food-only and food-plus-experience sessions, pre-existing travel plans, nearby purchases, paid reuse and separate tenant/operator fully loaded accounts.

hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Existing nearby provision already meets demand or users will not pay.
hypotheses.test: Obtain repeat-use commitments and compare incremental service access before permanent fit-out.

alternatives.A: Permanent building-led destination, conditional on measured demand, owners and downside funding
alternatives.B: Small anchor plus district venues and joint operations, proposed first test
alternatives.no_additional_project: Retain existing services and defer additional investment; ownership/maintenance obligations may remain

execution.sequence: 30 days investigation; by 90 days authorized paid pilot; by 365 days seasonal assessment; dates relative to agreed start
execution.owners: Before a pilot agree asset owner, operator, budget/risk/data owner, transport and culture partners
execution.continue: Paid demand plus committed revenue/funding covers full costs within agreed loss ceiling
execution.pivot: Adjust content, area, hours or district referrals when paid demand exists but format fails
execution.stop: No sustainable funds or operating conditions after adjustment; stop before agreed loss ceiling
execution.funding: Base cultural programme needs committed finance, not assumed future food profit; reinvestment is limited to eligible operator surplus after costs/reserves/working capital.

verification.method: Independent bounded urban/operating-strategy review and separate primary-source verifier
